default: Radio check{driver_comma} it's {engineer}. How do you read?
Radio check{driver_comma} {engineer} here. Do you copy?
british: Radio check{driver_comma} {engineer} here. How do you read me?

session.radio_check_reply: Copy, loud and clear. Good luck.
Perfect, reading you fine. Let's go.

motivating: Welcome to {track}! {session}{minutes_part}.{weather_part} Let's make it count.

session.spotter_intro: Spotter's on. I'll watch your sides.
flag.blue_leader: {car} is about to lap you, {gap} back. Let him by cleanly.
flag.fcy:advice_pit: Box this lap, the stop is cheap now.
flag.white: This is the last lap, bring it home.

british: Chequered flag. P{position}. Not bad at all.

penalty.track_limits: Track limit {count}, watch the white lines.
penalty.track_limits:last_warning: Track limit number {count}, the next one is a penalty.
penalty.reminder: Penalty still pending: {penalty}. Take it this lap.
Remember the penalty, {penalty}, serve it this lap.
gap.trend_rival:dropping: {car} is losing {tenths} a lap to you.
gap.catch_prediction: At this pace you'll be on {car} in {laps} laps.
Running {pace} you catch {car} in about {laps} laps.
rival.sector_strength: {car} is quicker in sector {sector}, defend there.
The car behind is stronger in the {sector_word} sector. Close the door there.
rival.attack_hint: You're faster than {car} in sector {sector}, attack there.
You have the edge on {car} in the {sector_word} sector.
fuel.status:enough: Fuel is good for {laps_possible} laps, you need {laps_needed}.
Fuel's fine. {laps_possible} laps in the tank, {laps_needed} needed.
fuel.status:short: Fuel for {laps_possible} laps, you need {laps_needed}. We'll have to refuel.
Fuel for {laps_possible} laps, not enough without a stop.
fuel.critical: Watch the fuel! Only {laps} laps left.
fuel.save_target: Save {save} litres a lap and we make it without stopping.{lift_part}
pit.window:open: The pit window is now open.
pit.window:mandatory_pending: Don't forget, the mandatory stop is still open.
pit.window:closing: Pit window closing soon, mandatory stop still open!
pit.exit_position: After the stop you'll come out P{position}{behind_part}.
pit.plan:reminder: Plan: box on lap {lap}. Box next lap.
prerace.start_fuel: Start fuel for a {minutes} minute race: {fuel}.
tyre.cold: Tyres are still cold, careful in the first corners.
tyre.overheat: {wheel} is overheating, look after the tyres.
The {wheel} tyre is getting too hot.
tyre.pressure_next_stint: Pressure call for the next set: {deltas}.
tyre.wet_switch:to_wet_soon: Rain in {minutes} minutes, wets at the next stop.
Rain due in {minutes} minutes. We're planning wets.
tyre.wet_switch:to_wet_now: Track is wet, wets now! Box this lap.
Too wet for slicks, come in for wets.
tyre.wet_switch:to_dry: Track is drying, time for slicks.
brake.wear: Brake pads good for about {laps} more laps.
brake.temp: The {axle} brakes are getting too hot.
damage.report:worth: Damage is costing about {loss} a lap. Repair is worth it.
That damage costs {loss} a lap, we should fix it.
damage.report:not_worth: Damage costs about {loss} a lap, repair isn't worth it.
Minor damage, {loss} a lap. Keep going.
damage.report:unknown: We have damage {where}. I'll watch the pace.
Damage {where}, I'll come back with numbers.
assist.tc: Lots of TC in turn {corner}, try one click down.
Traction control working hard in turn {corner}.
car.stint_time: {minutes} minutes of driving time left in this stint.
weather.forecast:rain_coming: Rain on the way: {intensity} in about {minutes} minutes.
weather.forecast:rain_stopping: Forecast says the rain is easing.
track.grip:faster: More grip, the track is coming to us.
track.grip:wetter: Track is getting wetter, less grip.
Grip is dropping, it's getting wet.
track.temp:falling: Track temperature falling, {delta} in ten minutes. Keep an eye on pressures.
track.temp:rising: Track temperature rising, {delta} in ten minutes.
lap.corner_feedback:braked_late: Turn {corner}: braked too late, you're missing the apex.
lap.corner_feedback:slow_apex: Turn {corner}: too slow at the apex, {kmh} km/h down.
More speed through turn {corner}, {kmh} km/h at the apex.
lap.corner_feedback:late_throttle: Turn {corner}: late on the throttle, about {meters}.
Get on the power earlier out of turn {corner}, {meters}.
lap.biggest_loss: Most time lost in turn {corner}, {loss} to your best.

motivating: Purple in the {sector_word} sector, great stuff!

setup.handling:understeer_entry: Understeer on corner entry, especially in the slow corners.
The car is pushing on turn-in.
setup.handling:oversteer_exit: Oversteer on exit, careful with the throttle.
The rear is stepping out on exit.
driver.after_mistake:reassure: Forget it, the pace is good.
It happens. Focus on the next corner.
driver.after_mistake:factual: Off. Check the tyres and continue.
quali.traffic_gap: Car ahead, make a {gap} second gap.
quali.push_now: Gap is clear, tyres are in, push now.
quali.time_for_lap:one: {minutes} minutes left, enough for exactly one lap.
quali.time_for_lap:two: {minutes} minutes left, enough for two laps.
quali.time_for_lap:none: Not enough time for another lap.
prerace.formation: Formation lap. Get heat into the tyres and brakes.
stint.deg_high: The tyres are dropping off noticeably.
crew.ack:recurring: Copy, I'll do that from now on.
crew.reminder: You asked me to remind you: {text}.
crew.ai_unavailable: Free questions aren't available right now, the standard calls keep running.
I can't answer free questions at the moment.
crew.no_data: I don't have data for that.
The game doesn't give us that, sorry.
answer.no_live: I don't have live data right now.
